notes.title: Thank You! 🎉 Feedback Update Coming Soon
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45686519/ebf1d439b831e8085a2dc93a178ff26bfa8a3437.jpg"]



Hey Champs! 🥊

We just hit 100 wishlists and crossed 900+ downloads on the demo — thank you all so much for playing, sharing, and leaving feedback. We’re honestly blown away by the support 💥

We’ve been listening closely to your input across Twitter, TikTok, Discord, Reddit, and Steam — and we’re already deep in the lab working on an update to the demo.

Here are just a few of the areas we’re focusing on:

Improving fighter visuals, animations, and feel

Making camera movement more comfortable in multiplayer

Updating audio and impact feedback

Smoothing out controls and adding better movement cues

Exploring replayability with more variety on the horizon 👀

We’ll be sharing an official changelist soon, but just know the next version is already cooking and your feedback is helping shape what comes next. 💪

Thanks again for stepping into the ring with us.
🧡 The Punch Champs Team
